column1: # Quantum-safety classification of JDK algorithm names, used by the pqc rule pack.
# Generated from the provider registry of JDK 26 (Oracle, Windows: SUN, SunRsaSign, SunEC,
# SunJSSE, SunJCE, SunMSCAPI) plus its TLS parameters and XML DSig SignatureMethod constants.
# PqcCatalogCompletenessTest fails when the running JDK exposes a name this file and the
# NOT_ASYMMETRIC prefixes in PqcCatalog do not classify: add the name here, do not widen a prefix.
# Columns (tab-separated): request type, classification, family, role, names (canonical first,
# then aliases and OIDs, comma-separated). Role is - for POST_QUANTUM.
# JOSE/JWT algorithm constants (RFC 7518 names as JJWT and Nimbus spell them).
